text: This report recommends settlement with the 10 Community Centres (Association of Community Centres or AOCCs) on their Core Administration Operations for 2016 based on audited financial results.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct that the accumulated surpluses of $48,630 from seven Association of Community Centres be paid to the City of Toronto and be used to fund the operating deficits of $26,726 for the core administration operations of two centres, resulting in a net receivable of $21,904 for operating under-expenditures as detailed in Table 2 of the report (March 2, 2018) from the Interim Chief Financial Officer.
